scope: M3 storage-layout validation and cold-transfer journal skeleton (no data move/recall/GC)
behavior: planLayout: hot/cold/authority/staging/reports/cold journal remain under one local data root; no production root is created
validateLocalRoot: absolute-only, rejects UNC/network, parent traversal, source-tree overlap, non-existent/non-directory root, symlink/junction segments, and production C: unless allowC fixture
injected volume probe rejects network/removable; requireVolumeType=true fails closed when unknown
cold journal records metadata/digests only (no memory text) with prepared→copied_verified→index_switched→source_cleaned transitions, atomic writes, duplicate/wrong-order rejection
recover lists valid journals and reports corrupt ones fail-closed; digest tamper is rejected
limitations: MEM-302 layered recall/cold read, MEM-303 cold/open cleanup propagation, and actual body transfer are NOT implemented.
The production data root is not created or provisioned; only validation/planning is provided.
Volume type is an injected probe in tests; no real OS volume-type probe or ACL check was executed.
No real cold tier E2E test, no crash-during-copy test with actual bodies, no backup/restore integration.
Cold dirs are created only by tests under the system temp drive; production non-C root remains unverified.
